title: Giants offense delivers when John Harbaugh ‘cracked’ to cap best day of camp: ‘We wanted it’

sources.name: Yahoo Sports NFL
sources.title: Giants offense delivers when John Harbaugh ‘cracked’ to cap best day of camp: ‘We wanted it’
sources.description: Like concert-goers pleading for an encore song, the Giants’ starting offense asked head coach John Harbaugh for a shot to finish off a drive.
